name: Trend following: robustness and walk-forward (BTC, ETH 1d)

sections.hypothesis: The trend-vol-target rule's 2020-2025 result (Sharpe 1.21 BTC, 1.23 ETH, the strongest in the trial log) is not an accident of its exact settings, and choosing its settings on past data predicts how they do on the following months.
sections.rationale: The original note (trend-following-with-volatility-targeting-btc) was rejected on BTC's drawdown and stays rejected; a 2017-2018 test on unseen data was also rejected. This note asks two different questions with P3's tools: is the result a plateau or a peak (robustness), and does it hold up when settings are chosen out of sample (walk-forward)? Passing both would make trend following the candidate for a forward test (paper trading or the holdout), not reverse either rejection. Written after the 2020-2025 results were seen; the grid and pass rules below are fixed before these studies run.
sections.rules: Implementation trend-vol-target, daily bars, 2020-01 to 2025-10, 330 USDT, costs from kestrel.toml. Robustness: kestrel robustness from the default setting (fast 20, mid 60, slow 120 days, vol 30 days, target vol 50%), each parameter moved to 0.5, 0.75, 1.25 and 1.5 times its value within its allowed range; settings where the lookbacks no longer increase cannot run and are reported. Walk-forward: kestrel walk-forward with 24-month training and 6-month test windows (7 folds), choosing by training Sharpe from slow_days in {90, 120, 180} x target_vol_pct in {30, 50, 70}, the other parameters at their defaults (9 grid points).
sections.falsification: Run once each on BTCUSDT 1d and ETHUSDT 1d. Reject unless, on both markets: (1) robustness says ROBUST (at least 80% of neighbouring settings keep a positive Sharpe and their median Sharpe is at least half the default's); and (2) walk-forward survives (out-of-sample Sharpe at least half the in-sample Sharpe of the chosen settings). Every setting tried counts as a trial in the deflated Sharpe.
sections.parameters: Robustness starts from the defaults. Walk-forward grid: slow_days 90/120/180 x target_vol_pct 30/50/70, with fast_days 20, mid_days 60, vol_days 30.
sections.costs: As in the original test: about 22 bps per round trip and a drag under 1% a year. Costs are not expected to decide this; stability is.

history.reason: Pre-registered validation, 1d 2020-01..2025-10. Robustness: ROBUST on both (all 20 neighbouring settings positive; median Sharpe 1.22 BTC, 1.21 ETH vs 1.21/1.23 at the defaults). Walk-forward (slow 90/120/180 x target vol 30/50/70%, 24-month training, 6-month tests, 7 folds): BTC survives (out-of-sample Sharpe 0.97, 92% of in-sample 1.06; holding BTC over the same windows: Sharpe 0.71, drawdown -67%); ETH fails (0.28, 32% of in-sample 0.88). Both markets had to pass, so rejected. 'BTC only' is not a rescue: it was chosen after seeing ETH fail. Studies 20261112-062244/062245/062255/062256.
